title: Single-deck stairs: height at the limit, depth too short
why: The 270 mm depth is permitted only on double deck trains.

spec.name: Single-deck stairs: height at the limit, depth too short

stairs.step_height_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.8(1): 'maximum height of 200 mm and a minimum depth of 280 mm ... For double deck trains it is permitted to reduce this value to 270 mm': 200 ≤ 200.

stairs.step_depth_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.8(1): 'maximum height of 200 mm and a minimum depth of 280 mm ... For double deck trains it is permitted to reduce this value to 270 mm': the unit is single deck, so 280 mm applies; 275 < 280.
